verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in the documentation-only tracking change. The new record carefully distinguishes honest witness-generation failures from constraint-level enforcement, explicitly says the existing failure test and force-vs-Brillig differential cannot prove the removed constraint is redundant, and keeps the upstream draft blocked pending a witness-bypass or witness-mutation verifier test. It also treats the reported measurement labels and counts only as consistency evidence, not provenance, and requires confirmation or a reproducible rerun before relying on the gate row. The safety argument remains appropriately qualified as plausible rather than certified, records that no acceptance criteria were run, and retains the sq-qhy4 external-audit limitation. The companion program update accurately summarizes those limitations. With no prior-round issues and no new issues, progress is stagnant.
